items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: I think Amos Raleigh had a band at that time that used to do that work for the merry-go-round. I don't know, definitely, but I think he's the band that was playing for them in those days.

ctx.x: Same location where it was. So I considered about one of the oldest pleasure clubs they got around here. I mean, that still didn't exist. Yeah, all the rest of them, they make up and they stay a while and they break up. There ain't never much to it. Now, the merry-go-round, I was too small to know what band, which I believe I do know what band was playing for them too. I think Amos Raleigh had a band at that time that used to do that work for the merry-go-round. I don't know, definitely, but I think he's the band…
And the cooperators, maybe we can get the location of that. That's still there, that's the Hope's hall.
